Summary: Microsoft's Zero Trust Assessment, run by Maester, with every result in the Maester report.

Prerequisites.Text: Install the Zero Trust Assessment module once.

Steps.Text: Connect Maester to the tenant. The pack is skipped while Maester is not connected to Graph.

Notes: You don't run Connect-ZtAssessment yourself: the assessment runs in its own PowerShell process, and Maester signs in there for you.
After an interactive Connect-Maester you sign in a second time, in the browser. Without a browser, set ZeroTrustAssessment.Connect to { "UseDeviceCode": true }.
The assessment can take an hour or more on a large tenant. Raise Execution.LongRunningTimeoutSeconds in maester-config.json if Maester stops it first.

Options.Name: ZeroTrustAssessment.Pillar
Options.Text: Run one pillar only: Identity, Devices, Network, Data, Infrastructure, SecOps or AI.

Options.Name: ZeroTrustAssessment.Tests
Options.Text: Run only these assessment test IDs, for example ["21770", "21771"].

Options.Name: ZeroTrustAssessment.Days
Options.Text: Days of sign-in logs the assessment reads (1 to 30).

Options.Name: ZeroTrustAssessment.Connect
Options.Text: Further Connect-ZtAssessment parameters, for example { "Service": ["Graph", "Azure"], "UseDeviceCode": true }.

Options.Name: ZeroTrustAssessment.ShowLog
Options.Text: List the tests the assessment runs in its live output.

Options.Name: ZeroTrustAssessment.EmbedReport
Options.Text: Embed the assessment's own HTML report in the Maester report.

Options.Name: ZeroTrustAssessment.OutputPath
Options.Text: Where the assessment writes its report and export. Kept when set.

Options.Name: ZeroTrustAssessment.ReportPath
Options.Text: Read a report you already have instead of running the assessment.

Options.Name: ZeroTrustAssessment.DisableTelemetry
Options.Text: The assessment sends the tenant ID to Microsoft unless this is true.

AppOnly.Text: Connect Maester to Graph app-only with a certificate. The assessment uses the same app and certificate, found by its thumbprint in the certificate store. Give the app the Graph permissions below; Get-ZtGraphScope lists them.
OtherRoles: The assessment's Azure, Exchange Online, Security & Compliance and SharePoint tests need the roles the Zero Trust Assessment documentation lists for app-only sign-in. To leave them out, set ZeroTrustAssessment.Connect to { "Service": ["Graph"] }.
